nine_does_not_establish.accounts_overdue: A register flag that accounts are overdue does not establish the reason, whether the company is trading, or any wrongdoing.
nine_does_not_establish.confirmation_statement_overdue: A register flag that a confirmation statement is overdue does not establish the reason, whether the company is trading, or any wrongdoing.
nine_does_not_establish.idv_statement_overdue: A register record that a statement is overdue is not a finding that the person is unverified or that an offence has occurred.
nine_does_not_establish.idv_statement_removed: A removed statement record does not establish why it was removed or the person's current verification position.
nine_does_not_establish.active_psc_statements: A PSC statement records what the company told the register. It does not establish who owns or controls the company or that the statement is accurate.
nine_does_not_establish.ceased_psc_statements: A ceased statement is a historical register record. It does not establish the current position or that the statement was accurate.
nine_does_not_establish.previous_names: A previous name is a register record. It does not establish why the name changed.
nine_does_not_establish.insolvency_history: An insolvency record does not establish current solvency, cause or outcome.
nine_does_not_establish.outstanding_charges: The register status of a charge does not establish the amount secured, the value of the assets or the company's ability to pay.
